## What's free

Unlimited repos with up to 5 collaborators; CI/CD minutes, Pages, Container Registry

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://about.gitlab.com/pricing/> before relying on this.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
